name: examples-dogfood-rabbitmq-worker-app
description: Dogfood app 2 (v1.11-3) — order-processing worker driven by @kiwa-lab/queue (RabbitMQ basic + advanced) in `KIWA_MODE=mock` and by amqplib against a live rabbitmq:3-management broker in `KIWA_MODE=real`; behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-lab/queue -F @kiwa-lab/core -F @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
